title: Annotatio III §.III: Later year — they also agree a Sacred Supper Formula (summary at p. 335): teach per Augsburg Confession that Christ is truly, vivifically, and substantially present
pass_a_gloss: IN THE LATER YEAR, reasons having been compared, they also consent to this Formula concerning the Sacred Supper (whose summary our Author also recites at page 335): Concerning this Article, they say, it ought to be taught in our Churches according to the Augsburg Confession, namely that in this Ordinance of the Sacred Supper of our Lord Jesus Christ, Christ is truly, vivifically, and Substantially present, and with the bread and wine thus ordained by him exhibits his Body and Blood to be eaten and drunk to us Christians, and testifies that we are his members, and that he gives himself together with the promise of Grace to us, and that he is efficacious in us and works, just as Hilary says: These things taken and drunk make Christ to be in us and us in him.
pass_b_english: In the later year, after comparing reasons, they also agree on a Formula for the Sacred Supper (our author summarizes it at p. 335).
On this article, they say, our churches must teach according to the Augsburg Confession: in the Lord’s ordinance of the Sacred Supper, Christ is truly, vivifically, and substantially present.

With the bread and wine he has so ordained, he exhibits his body and blood for Christians to eat and drink, testifies that we are his members, gives himself with the promise of grace, and works efficaciously in us — as Hilary says: what is taken and drunk makes Christ to be in us and us in him.
source_text: POSTERIORI ANNO, collatis rationibus, in hanc de Sacra Coena quoque Formulam (cujus summarium Autor quoque noster pagina 335. recitat) consentiunt: De hoc Articulo, inquiunt, in Ecclesiis nostris doceri debet juxta Augustanam Confessionem, nempe quod in hac Domini nostri Jesu Christi Ordinatione Sacrae Coenae, vere, vivificè & Substantialiter Christus praesens sit, & cum pane & vino sic ab ipso ordinatis, Corpus & Sanguinem suum manducandum & bibendum nobis Christianis exhibeat, atque testetur, quod ipsius membra simus, & quòd se ipsum una cum promissione Gratiae nobis donet, & quod in nobis sit efficax & operetur, quemadmodum Hilarius inquit: Haec sumta & hausta, faciunt, ut Christus sit in nobis & nos in ipso.

lemmas.latin: vere, vivificè & Substantialiter Christus praesens sit
lemmas.gloss: Christ is truly, vivifically, and substantially present
